label: Copy phase from the 3rd output on, mainly when the fed-back input is b/s/i/a/u/q
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, from recall_idx 2 onward. It never fires during the original tokens, at <DEL>, or on the first fed-back copy input (in_first=1 steps are always inactive, so it is never active on a token seen for the first time). Within that window it fires on about 14% of steps. The input token matters most: b is highest (25% rate, 5.1x lift), then s, i, a, u, q. The top activations are almost all on b, i or a late in length-9 sequences. Rate also depends on position: highest at recall_idx 2-3 and 7-8 (t=11-12, 16-17) and lowest around t=13-14. Longer sequences fire more (L=9 carries 49% of the mass). Restricting to the six tokens gives dev F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.72. The rest of the activation is spread over many other tokens with a weak preference for prev_tok k/v. This is a dense, token-tuned copy-phase gate whose exact firing is not captured by simple input variables.
